title: Johnson bound in radius form
statement:
Fix integers $n, d, w$ with $n \ge 1$, $1 \le d$, and $2d \le n$, and suppose that $w \le J_2(n,d) = \tfrac{1}{2}\bigl(n - \sqrt{n\,(n-2d)}\bigr)$. Then the maximum size $A_0(n,d,w)$ of an $(n,d,w)$-admissible binary code — a set of binary words of length $n$ in which any two distinct words are at Hamming distance at least $d$ and every word has weight at most $w$ — satisfies
\[
A_0(n,d,w) \;\le\; 2n.
\]
replaced:
If $n > 0$, $1 \le d$, $2d \le n$, and $w \le J_2(n,d)$, then
\[
A_0(n,d,w) \;\le\; 2n.
\]
